items.reason: The PR replaces the configured value with 10 * 1024 for every HTTP 413 response in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/lib/utilities.js:245-247; config/locales/client.en.yml:1297 displays it as the maximum allowed size. Although config/nginx.sample.conf:61 defaults to 10m, a deployment with a lower web-server limit will reject uploads while this message incorrectly advertises 10 MB.
